about: Python-side cells of the Azure transition model (docs/design-azure-state-matrix.md section 5): what Azure answers at the settings-check stage, and what doctor and the preflight each conclude. Every body is Azure's own, with its source. Read by tests/test_azure_transition_contract.py.

ok_chat.source: shape of a chat completion (the fields the client reads)

unauthorized.source: live probe 19 Nov 2026 (bad key, both good and bad deployment)

error.message: Access denied due to invalid subscription key or wrong API endpoint. Make sure to provide a valid key for an active subscription and use a correct regional API endpoint for your resource.

deployment_not_found.source: live probe 19 Nov 2026 (good key, deployment that does not exist)

error.message: The API deployment for this resource does not exist. If you created the deployment within the last 5 minutes, please wait a moment and try again.

generic_404.source: live probe 19 Nov 2026 (portal URL, classic URL, http endpoint, wrong path: all identical)

cap_refusal.source: live probes 12 and 19 Nov 2026 (gpt-4.1-mini deployment, max_tokens 64000)

error.message: max_tokens is too large: 64000. This model supports at most 32768 completion tokens, whereas you provided 64000.

throttled.source: Azure's documented 429 shape (not probed: throttling cannot be provoked cheaply)

outage.source: generic 503 (not probed: an outage cannot be provoked)
